transcript.en: Good Morning. Youth Council.
transcript.zh: 早上好，这里是青年委员会。

transcript.en: Caroline speaking.
transcript.zh: 我是Caroline。

transcript.en: Oh hello I'm interested in standing for election to the Youth Council.
transcript.zh: 您好，我想参加青年委员会竞选。

transcript.en: And I was told to give you a call.
transcript.zh: 他们叫我给您打个电话。

transcript.en: That's good.
transcript.zh: 很好。

transcript.en: Could I have your name	 please?
transcript.zh: 请问你叫什么名字？

transcript.en: Yes it's Roger Brown.
transcript.zh: 我叫Roger Brown。

transcript.en: Thank you.
transcript.zh: 谢谢你。

transcript.en: I'm Caroline the Youth Council administrator.
transcript.zh: 我叫Caroline，是青年委员会的管理员。

transcript.en: So do you know much about what the Council does Roger?
transcript.zh: 你对我们青年委员会的工作有多少了解呢，Roger？

transcript.en: I've talked to Stephanie - I think she's the chair of the Council.
transcript.zh: 我和Stephanie联系过，我记得她好像是青年委员会的主席。

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: And she told me a lot about it.
transcript.zh: 她跟我讲了很多委员会的事情。

transcript.en: How it's a way for young people to discuss local issues, for example, and make suggestions to the town council.
transcript.zh: 比如，它是一种年轻人讨论当地事件的途径，还能通过青年委员会向市议会提建议

transcript.en: That's what made me interested.
transcript.zh: 正是这些让我对青年委员会产生了兴趣。

transcript.en: Fine. Well, let me take down some of your details.
transcript.zh: 好的，我现在要记录一下你的个人信息。

transcript.en: First of all how old are you?
transcript.zh: 首先，你多大了？

transcript.en: You know the Council is for young people aged from 13 to 18?
transcript.zh: 你知道委员会面向的是13-18岁的年轻人，对吧？

transcript.en: I've just turned 18.
transcript.zh: 我今年刚满18岁。

transcript.en: And where do you live Roger?
transcript.zh: Roger，你住在哪里？

transcript.en: Well that's a bit complicated.
transcript.zh: 嗯......这个有点复杂。

transcript.en: At the moment I'm looking for a flat to rent here	 so I'm in a hostel from Monday to Friday.
transcript.zh: 我现在还在找可以租的公寓，所以从星期一到星期五我都住在一个青年旅社。

transcript.en: I go back to my parents' place at the weekend.
transcript.zh: 周末的时候我会回父母家住。

transcript.en: OK, so where's the best place to send you some information about the Council?
transcript.zh: 好吧，那如果我们要给你寄一些委员会的资料，最好寄到哪里？

transcript.en: Oh to my parents' address please.
transcript.zh: 哦，请寄到我父母家。

transcript.en: That's 17 Buckleigh Street- B-U-C-K-L-E-I-G-H Street	 Stamford Lincolnshire though you don't really need the county.
transcript.zh: 地址是：林肯郡斯坦福德县 Buckleigh大街17号，大街名字的拼写是B-U-C-K-L-E-I-G-H ，不过您应该知道我们县。

transcript.en: Oh I know Stamford - it's a lovely town.
transcript.zh: 对，我知道斯坦福德县，一个很不错的地方

transcript.en: And what's the postcode?
transcript.zh: 邮编是什么？

transcript.en: PE9 7QT
transcript.zh: PE9 7QT

transcript.en: Right thank you.
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢。

transcript.en: So are you working here	 or are you a student?
transcript.zh: 请问你是在这里工作还是学习？

transcript.en: I started studying at the university a couple of weeks ago and I've got a part-time job for a few hours a week.
transcript.zh: 我是几个星期前开始在这里上大学的，每个星期还做几个小时的兼职。

transcript.en: What do you do?
transcript.zh: 什么兼职？

transcript.en: Well, I've done several different things.
transcript.zh: 我已经做过好几种不同的兼职了。

transcript.en: I've just finished a short-term contract as a courier and now I'm working as a waiter in one of the big hotels.
transcript.zh: 我的短期导游的合同刚结束，现在正在一个大酒店当服务生。

transcript.en: Uhuh. That can't leave you much time for studying!
transcript.zh: 嗯，那这样的话你应该没多少时间可以用来学习吧？

transcript.en: Oh it's not too bad.
transcript.zh: 也没那么严重。

transcript.en: I manage to fit it all in.
transcript.zh: 我设法把所有时间都安排好了。

transcript.en: What are you studying?
transcript.zh: 你学的是什么？

transcript.en: My ambition is to go into parliament eventually so my major subject is politics.
transcript.zh: 我的梦想是以后进入议会工作，所以我选了政治专业。

transcript.en: That's partly why I think the Youth Council is important and want to be a part of it.
transcript.zh: 这也是我认为青年委员会很重要并且想要加入的部分原因。

transcript.en: And I suppose you're also taking a minor subject	 aren't you?
transcript.zh: 我想你应该也在学习一门辅课，对吗？

transcript.en: I know a lot of people study economics too.
transcript.zh: 我知道很多人还选择了学习经济。

transcript.en: I chose history.
transcript.zh: 我选的是历史。

transcript.en: To be honest I'm not finding it as interesting as I expected!
transcript.zh: 但是说实话，我觉得这门课没有我想象中那么有趣。

transcript.en: OK so with your studying and your part-time job
transcript.zh: 好的。既然你又要学习又要做兼职，

transcript.en: do you have time for any other interests or hobbies?
transcript.zh: 那你还有时间进行其他的兴趣爱好吗？

transcript.en: Well,	 l spend quite a lot of time cycling - both around town to get to university and to work
transcript.zh: 我还会骑很长时间的自行车，去上学和上班我都是骑自行车的，

transcript.en: and also long-distance from here to London for instance.
transcript.zh: 另外我也会骑很长的距离，比如从这儿骑车去伦敦。

transcript.en: That's pretty impressive!
transcript.zh: 太令人钦佩了，

transcript.en: Anything else?
transcript.zh: 你还有其他的爱好吗？

transcript.en: For relaxation I'm also keen on the cinema - I used to go at least once a week
transcript.zh: 为了放松我也喜欢去看电影，以前我至少一个星期会去看一次电影，

transcript.en: but I can't manage to go so often now.
transcript.zh: 不过现在没法儿去那么多次了。

transcript.en: Right. Are you sure you'll have enough time for the Youth Council?
transcript.zh: 没错。你确定你有足够的时间加入青年委员会吗？

transcript.en: Yes. I've worked out that I can afford to reduce my hours at work and that will make the time.
transcript.zh: 确定，我算了算减少一点兼职时间也是可以的，这样我就能空出时间了。

transcript.en: So is there any particular aspect of the Youth Council's work that appeals to you Roger?
transcript.zh: Roger，青年委员会的工作有没有特别吸引你的方面？

transcript.en: Well, my sister is blind so I'm particularly interested in working with disabled young people
transcript.zh: 有的，我姐姐是个盲人，所以我特别想跟身患残疾的年轻人一起工作，

transcript.en: to try and improve the quality of their lives.
transcript.zh: 努力改善他们的生活质量。

transcript.en: That's great.
transcript.zh: 你能有这个想法真是太伟大了。

transcript.en: Well, the best way to get involved is to be nominated by some people who you know.
transcript.zh: 最好的参与进来的方法就是让一些你认识的人给你提名。

transcript.en: Right. Can you tell me how to set about organising that?
transcript.zh: 好的，您能不能告诉我要怎么着手组织呢？

transcript.en: You should talk to Jeffrey our Elections Officer.
transcript.zh: 你应该跟我们的竞选负责人Jeffrey聊一聊。

transcript.en: I can arrange a meeting in the council office with him if you like.
transcript.zh: 如果你愿意的话，我可以帮你安排在委员会办公室跟他见一面。

transcript.en: Yes please.
transcript.zh: 好的，拜托您了。

transcript.en: He'll be here next Monday if that suits you.
transcript.zh: 他下个星期一会过来，你这个时间方便吗？

transcript.en: That's the 14th isn't it?
transcript.zh: 那天是14号，对吧？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 对。

transcript.en: I can manage late afternoon.
transcript.zh: 我下午晚一点可以想办法过来。

transcript.en: Would you like to suggest a time?
transcript.zh: 你可以讲个具体的时间吗？

transcript.en: He generally leaves around 5.30.
transcript.zh: 他一般5:30左右就走了。

transcript.en: Well, would 4.30 be OK?
My last class finishes at 4 so I'd have plenty of time to get to your office.
transcript.zh: 我最后一节课是四点钟结束，这样我就有充足的时间可以来办公室了。

transcript.en: Right that's fine.
transcript.zh: 好的，没问题。

transcript.en: Oh and could I have a phone number we can contact you on?
transcript.zh: 对了，你给我一个可以联系到你的电话号码吧。

transcript.en: Yes my mobile number's 07788 136711.
Thank you. Well we'll look forward to seeing you next week.
transcript.zh: 谢谢，我们很期待下星期跟你见面。

transcript.en: Thanks very much. Goodbye.
transcript.zh: 非常感谢，再见。

transcript.en: Bye.
transcript.zh: 再见。
